verdict: WATCH — re-screened 2026-07-05: valuation-only mechanism, defensive DIY mix; re-open on H2 comps holding or ~$12
underwriting: $14.46; consolidated comps +1.3%; net debt ~1.7x & falling; FV $16/$20/$22

edge_explainer.market_believes: Sally Beauty is a declining brick-and-mortar beauty-supply retailer losing share to Amazon/Ulta/mass, carrying too much leverage — a levered dying-retail story.
edge_explainer.we_believe: The 'dying retail' frame is refuted by the data: consolidated comps +1.3% with Sally comps positive on BOTH traffic AND unit-retail, gross-margin-led improvement (Fuel-for-Growth), net debt ~1.7x and FALLING. CosmoProf pro-distribution (licensed professionals, B2B) is stickier than the walk-in-retail narrative assumes.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: Structural/behavioral: a $1.5B levered small-cap with no growth story gets no coverage and screens as dying-retail. The honest thesis: total return = re-rate + ~6%/yr buyback + de-leveraging — NOT organic growth. Risk-premium harvest on an over-done secular discount.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: +1.3% comps is barely positive, the business is not growing, and beauty-supply IS structurally exposed to e-commerce and Ulta. If comps tip negative, the re-rate+de-lever math inverts — leverage on a declining top line is how retail value traps blow up.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: Sally comps positive over the next 2-3 prints, net-debt/EBITDA continuing to fall, gross-margin gains holding, buyback shrinking the count.
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: Sally comps turn negative / net-debt/EBITDA rises / gross-margin gains fade — any one re-opens the levered-dying-retail bear.
edge_explainer.edge_type: risk-premium harvest — 'dying retail' verified-refuted; return = re-rate + buyback + de-lever, explicitly NOT organic growth; no timing edge claimed

sizing: 1% starter (deep-value basket slot; beauty-discretionary flag caps it)
